verdict.rationale: Framer brings real code into the design canvas through Code Components (custom React components with visual controls) and Code Overrides, and designs ship as live sites through its publishing pipeline. A community comment notes its React basis lets designers hand widgets to developers. However, nothing in the evidence shows designs exporting as code a developer can ship in their own codebase; the 'production' output is the Framer-hosted site. Missing for 10: documented design-to-code export, component-to-codebase mapping (Code Connect-style), independent hands-on confirmation of shippable code output.
